summary: Smart Digital Group Ltd (Nasdaq: SDM) filed a Form 6-K disclosing receipt of a Nasdaq delisting notice on June 17, 2026. Nasdaq determined to delist the company under Listing Rule IM-5101-4 due to an SEC-issued trading suspension on September 29, 2025, citing potential third-party manipulation. Unless the company appeals by June 24, 2026, trading will be suspended June 26, and Nasdaq will file a Form 25-NSE to complete delisting. An appeal would stay suspension pending a Panel decision. The company is evaluating options. Watch for appeal outcome and potential OTC trading if delisted.
